t: A $(item)Kerosene Lamp/$ is a powerful light source that runs on.. you guessed it, $(l:manufacturing/refinery)Kerosene/$. It is similar to the long range light sources you might be used to, like $(thing)Thaumcraft's Arcane Lamp)/$.$(p)$(italic)Technically, the lamp will run on any burnable fuel, but Kerosene is more efficient than any other fuel in this lamp, even LPG./$
$(item)煤油灯/$是一种强力光源，顾名思义，它使用$(l:manufacturing/refinery)煤油/$运行。它和你可能早已熟悉的那些远距离照明光源很像，例如$(thing)神秘时代的奥术灯)/$。$(p)$(italic)严格来说，这盏灯可以使用任何可燃燃料，但在这盏灯中，煤油比其他任何燃料都更高效，甚至比 LPG 还高。/$

The $(item)Kerosene Lamp/$ has a default range of 10 blocks. However, this can be adjusted in the GUI up to a maximum of 30 blocks. Note that the higher the range, the more fuel the lamp will use, in a squared fashion. So when you double the range, the fuel usage is multiplied by 4!$(p)However, the lamp only uses a small amount of fuel. With 1000mB of Kerosene and the default range of 10 blocks, the Lamp can run for about $(ttcolor)$(t:The Lamp's efficiency can be altered in mod config: see 'D:keroseneLampFuelEfficiency')40 real minutes/$.

$(item)煤油灯/$的默认照明范围为 10 格方块。不过，你可以在 GUI 中进行调整，最大可提升到 30 格方块。注意，范围越大，煤油灯消耗的燃料就越多，而且是按平方增长的。所以当你将范围加倍时，燃料消耗会变成 4 倍！$(p)不过，煤油灯本身消耗的燃料其实很少。使用 1000mB 的煤油，在默认 10 格方块范围下，煤油灯大约可以持续运行$(ttcolor)$(t:煤油灯的效率可在模组配置里调整：见 'D:keroseneLampFuelEfficiency')40 分钟现实时间/$。

The $(item)Kerosene Lamp/$ can be controlled by $(thing)redstone/$ like most $(pncr) blocks. Apart from the usual on/off modes, there also is an $(bold)Interpolate Signal/$ mode. This will (like the name says) interpolate the range of the lamp based on the signal strength.$(p)E.g. assuming the default max range of 10 blocks, when a $(#f00)redstone signal/$ of 8 (out of 15) is applied, the Lamp will have a range of 5.
$(item)煤油灯/$和大多数$(#228)气动工艺$()方块一样，也可以通过$(thing)红石/$控制。除了常见的开/关模式外，还有一种$(bold)插值信号/$模式。顾名思义，这会根据信号强度对灯的照明范围进行插值。$(p)例如，假设默认最大范围为 10 格，当施加的$(#f00)红石信号/$强度为 8（满值 15）时，煤油灯的范围将变为 5。
